notes.diagnosis_zh: 新增独立旋转公式检查发现：非线性角度预处理与 eager 反向套前向组合仍产生错误的二阶值。其余五种组合通过；不放宽数学断言，也不把新增失败藏在旧批次之外。
notes.next_zh: 追踪外部输入到 packed 参数的二阶链式关系及 TF 首次函数调用的导数图；同时保持符号编译、重复调用、无回调和三阶拒绝门禁。
notes.diagnosis: A new independent Bloch-rotation oracle detects an incorrect eager reverse-over-forward result with nonlinear angle preprocessing. The other five combinations pass; the new strict failure is retained.
notes.next: Audit external-to-packed second-order chain rules and first-call TF function graphs while preserving symbolic compilation, repeated runtime points, no callbacks and third-order guards.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 实际 TensorFlow 常量输入的双库比较仍失败；可训练 Variable 是另一个已保留的测试，不能用替换输入掩盖常量路径。失败来源与上游行为仍需单独定位。
notes.next_zh: 分别记录 Native 和指定版本 PennyLane 的常量与 Variable 原始行为，对照独立生成元公式，不替换接口或输入。
notes.diagnosis: The actual constant-TensorFlow-input comparison still fails. The separate trainable Variable case cannot substitute for the constant path; isolate Native versus reference behavior.
notes.next: Record each library's original constant and Variable behavior against the independent generator oracle without changing the interface or input.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 六个从标准文本加载的动态程序在再次默认导出时被变量 UUID/对象身份保护拒绝。不能移除所有身份保护来绕过问题。
notes.next_zh: 区分源文本产生的词法身份与调用者显式持有的 Native 变量身份；验证作用域、遮蔽、执行结果和必要的元数据丢失保护。
notes.diagnosis: Six dynamic programs loaded from standard source fail default re-export under UUID/object identity protection. Removing all identity protection is not an acceptable repair.
notes.next: Distinguish parser-created lexical identity from explicitly owned Native variables; preserve scopes, shadowing, execution and required metadata-loss protections.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 标准 switch/default 源码再次导出也触发变量身份拒绝；实际分支执行和词法引用必须一起验证。
notes.next_zh: 与动态作用域往返一并修复，保留所有原分支、计数与独立执行断言。
notes.diagnosis: Standard switch/default source hits the same variable-identity re-export refusal.
notes.next: Repair with dynamic lexical-scope round trips and preserve every branch, count and execution assertion.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 估计器期望值不同；Public SparsePauliOp 的右端位序与 Native 算子的左端位序必须区分，不能翻转已承诺的 V2 语义来制造通过。
notes.next_zh: 用完整复数矩阵与两个测量位置分别验证加载、Public/Native 算子和 V2 执行，定位合同迁移或实际映射缺陷。
notes.diagnosis: Estimator expectations differ. Public rightmost-first Pauli labels and Native leftmost-first labels must not be conflated or fixed by reversing the approved V2 semantics.
notes.next: Verify the full complex matrix and both measurement positions across decoding, Public/Native operators and V2 execution before deciding migration versus mapping defect.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 内外两层缓存时仍会误报三阶拒绝或给出错误的零混合导数。四个失败案例及其独立解析公式均保留，未改断言。
notes.next_zh: 修复嵌套缓存下参数与余切量的图入口；不使用主机量子回调，不移除导数阶数保护。
notes.diagnosis: Nested cached primal/derivative functions still produce a false third-order refusal or an incorrect zero mixed derivative. The independent analytic formulas and all four failing cases remain unchanged.
notes.next: Repair Native graph point/cotangent edges for nested cached forward-over-reverse and reverse-over-forward; do not use host quantum callbacks or remove derivative-order guards.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 旧断言要求 parameter-shift 在取值阶段拒绝执行；独立探针已在两个环境中验证分数幂及两种受控线路的数值、Jacobian 和 Hessian。此结果只证明 Native 参数移位路径，不代表纯张量特化或完整方法合同已验收。
notes.next_zh: 补齐方法、来源和资源合同的双环境验收后，仅就这一条拒绝断言提出迁移决策。获准前保留失败，不关闭已正确工作的功能来制造全绿。
notes.diagnosis: The old assertion demands rejection of parameter-shift at value execution. A separate strict probe now matches the independent stored values, Jacobians and Hessians for the fractional-power and both controlled cases. This is Native parameter-shift execution, not acceptance of a pure tensor specialization or of the complete method contract.
notes.next: Finish both-profile method, provenance and resource acceptance, then propose an explicit migration of only this rejection case. Keep the old assertion failing until approved; do not disable working functionality to obtain green checks.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 旧断言只计固定矩阵的数值存储，实际存活占用还包括 native_binding_object_storage。探针已拆分两种占用，垃圾回收没有消除绑定对象余额；实际持有者及其释放行为仍需审计。
notes.next_zh: 将每笔绑定对象预算追溯到数学快照和别名，验证终止释放与父预算竞争，再判断是生命周期缺陷还是旧计数合同冲突；不删有效预算，也不放松断言。
notes.diagnosis: The old assertion counts fixed numeric matrix storage only. The actual retained balance also includes native_binding_object_storage allowances. A probe separated the two categories and garbage collection did not remove the binding balance; actual ownership and release must still be audited.
notes.next: Trace each retained binding allowance to the mathematical snapshot and its aliases; verify terminal release and parent-budget competition before deciding whether this is a lifetime defect or an old counting-contract conflict. Do not remove valid reservations or loosen the assertion.

notes.diagnosis_zh: 共享账本的拒绝策略仍正确触发，但最终零存储断言失败。这不是绕过共享资源范围或清零实际占用计数器的理由。
notes.next_zh: 追踪 Jacobian 拒绝后仍存活的 Native 绑定持有者，核实预期生命周期和确定性释放；保留精确的策略错误与不消费额外工作量检查。
notes.diagnosis: The required shared-ledger refusal still occurs, but the final zero-live-storage assertion fails. This is not permission to bypass the shared scope or to zero the retained-storage counter.
notes.next: Determine which Native binding owners survive the failed Jacobian entry, verify their intended lifetime and deterministic release, and preserve the exact policy-error and non-consumption checks.
